## Channel 2

Three objects, and only one is live for *this* book.

**(a) FOMC/Warsh — PAID.** 25 bp hike to 3.75–4.00%, unanimous; SEP median 2026 FFR **4.1% vs June 3.8%**; October hike odds ~40% hold ~60%. Cash already sold it: XLY −0.63% after an open-then-fade. Chair does **not** speak today. Carrying S0=−1/−2 is restacking a completed session (08-28). News Judge’s “FOMC still the unresolved binary” is **stale vs the calendar**.

**(b) Oil — 08-11 does **not** re-fire.** Live sign is **down** ~1–1.6% with RBOB offered. Level remains a tax (~$104 / ~$108; AAA regular **$4.439**). NJ #3 “oil surges / tanker rates” is contradicted by Channel 1 and by NJ #4 (crude inventory build). Hormuz residual is a *level*, not a fresh kinetic increment. Do **not** put oil in S0.

**(c) Pre-binary tape.** Finviz futures modestly green, not a 09-11 ≥+0.5% mean-shift. VIX down, contango, gold **up**, 10Y–SPX corr dead. XLK is the PM leader — **08-27 forbids mapping that into S0=+1**. XLY’s own 1d rel (−0.19%) does not confirm participation. Discard yfinance ES/NQ **+1.71% / +2.10% vs prior close** (overnight already in).

**S0 = 0.** Paid hawkish FOMC, oil offered, futures inside ±0.5%, no same-day Chair. Not −1: that would re-vote yesterday. Not +1: 08-27 + sub-gate 1d rel. Regime **mixed**.

Do not treat TSLA as the sector.

Channel 1 1d rel **−0.19% (sub-gate)**; 3d/1w/1m still negative but **already in the price**. Live PM XLY **+0.61%** is mid/upper pack, not a breakdown. One trailing rel print may anchor **at most one** component; it is used here as “not confirming.” **S4 = 0.** Do not re-vote 09-16’s −0.63% as a fresh down tape.

**6. Earnings / policy catalysts**

FOMC paid. Claims unprinted two-sided. No Chair. Adobe/ASML are **XLK objects**. BNY prime rate +25 bp to 7.00% effective today confirms the hike regime but is not an XLY spend print.
